The sandbox-refusal test patches `sandbox.runtime` with `lambda: None` to simulate no container engine, then calls `adapter.invoke`. This works only if `invoke` calls `sandbox.runtime()` before `sandbox.run()`. If that ordering is implementation-defined rather than contractual, the test is coupled to the current call sequence. This is an observation about test fragility, not about correctness of the production change.
